answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 42905 Country: India Title: A tenancy home can be treated as ownership title in sharing of property between legal heirs Question: A tenancy home can be treated as ownership title in sharing of property between legal heirs? Answer ID: 42905 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 79/51/D=1434) Any tenancy home shall not be counted as inheritance of the tenant. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
